text: The Probabilistic Tsunami Hazard Assessment for Vanimo Port Design (PTHA–Vanimo) is an initiative aimed at assessing and mitigating tsunami risks for the Vanimo port in Papua New Guinea. It leverages the PTHA18 framework developed by Geoscience Australia, which provides a comprehensive set of earthquake-tsunami scenarios and guidelines tailored for Pacific Island countries. The initiative focuses on site-specific inundation modeling and design processes to enhance the resilience of port infrastructure against tsunami hazards.
